messages:
Anika Patel: Quick plan — compact welcome + webinar invite in wk2. Split audience into 'Core' (product-fit), 'Explorers' (trial light), and 'Platform' (integrations). Need copy, subject options, and timezone windows. Goal: improve 7-day NRR and webinar sign rate.

Marc: Segments — can we confirm criteria? I suggest: Core = active API keys + >5 calls/day, Explorers = trials <7 days active, Platform = integration interest tag.

Maya G: Draft subjects:
- "Welcome to Redwood — get lower latency in 3 steps"
- "You're in — join our practical inference webinar"
Let's A/B theme: benefits vs how-to.

Tom H: For routing, can we gate Explorer sends until they've seen the quickstart? Also, UTMs: ?utm_campaign=compact-welcome&utm_source=email&utm_medium=drip

Jess L: I'll own copy + run A/B with Maya. ETA EOD tomorrow for 2 variants per segment.

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled send window config missing for APAC. Use timezone rollups.

Anika Patel: send params (rough):
```
{ "segments": ["Core","Explorers","Platform"],
  "send_windows": {"NA": "9am-11am", "EU": "10am-12pm", "APAC": "8am-10am"},
  "variants": ["benefit","howto"],
  "webinar_cta": "wk2_thursday_12pm_PT"
}
```
Link to creative doc: https://docs.google.com/...?project=compact-welcome (working doc)

Marc: Can we add a fallback model variant for Dedicated customers? (different webinar CTA)

Maya G: Suggest adding a short survey CTA in second email for Explorers: 1-question about top blocker.

Jess L: cadence question — 3-day vs 7-day follow-up? I'd prefer 3-day for Explorers, 7-day for Core.

Tom H: Engagement gating: only send webinar invite if opened >=1 or clicked quickstart; otherwise send reminder drip.

Anika Patel: Owners: Jess (copy), Maya (subjects & survey), Tom (routing & UTMs), Marc (seg map + enterprise CTA). I'll schedule the sync tomorrow 11am PT. :white_check_mark:
